mergedParams.userDescription: Polaroid frame develop instant photo flick transition effects between videos

prompts.prompt: Create a polaroid instant photo develop transition where the outgoing video shrinks into a polaroid frame that shakes/flicks away while the incoming video develops from a white overexposed state inside a new polaroid frame. Use a 1.5 second overlap period where the outgoing polaroid scales down to 0.3x with a shake effect (alternating rotate-3/-rotate-3) and slides off-screen left, while the incoming polaroid slides in from right starting at 0.8x scale, growing to 1x. The incoming video should have a white overlay that fades from opacity-100 to opacity-0 simulating photo development. Add a subtle drop shadow to both polaroid frames and use a cream-colored border with 'p-4 bg-amber-50' for the polaroid effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.5s overlap. Two nested BaseLayouts as polaroid frames with 'relative bg-amber-50 p-4 shadow-xl' styling. VideoAtom for outgoing at startTime=0, VideoAtom for incoming at startTime=video1.duration-1.5s. Generic effects: outgoing polaroid gets scale(1→0.3), translateX(0→-150%), rotate with shake keyframes [0,-3,3,-3,0]deg over 1.5s. Incoming polaroid gets scale(0.8→1), translateX(150%→0). White overlay div on incoming video with opacity animation 1→0 over 1.5s for development effect.

prompts.prompt: Design a polaroid stack shuffle transition where multiple polaroid frames containing video segments fan out and reshuffle. During a 2-second overlap, create 3 duplicate frames of the outgoing video that spread out in a fan pattern (rotate -15deg, 0deg, 15deg) while fading out, as 3 preview frames of the incoming video slide up from the bottom in a similar fan, consolidating into one frame. Each polaroid should have realistic instant photo proportions with white borders and a larger bottom border for the caption area. Add a subtle paper texture overlay and slight sepia tone filter during transition.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with calculated duration. Create 6 nested BaseLayouts as polaroid frames (3 outgoing, 3 incoming) with 'aspect-[3/4] bg-white p-3 pb-12 shadow-2xl'. Outgoing frames at z-10,20,30 with staggered start times, incoming at z-40,50,60. Generic effects for fan-out: rotate(-15/0/15deg), translateY(-10/0/10%), opacity(1→0). Fan-in effects: translateY(100%→0), rotate(15/0/-15deg→0), opacity(0→1). Apply sepia filter with 'sepia-[.2]' during overlap period only.

prompts.prompt: Build a vintage polaroid camera flash transition where the screen flashes white (simulating camera flash) as the outgoing video freezes into a polaroid that gets 'ejected' downward with a curved motion path, while simultaneously a new polaroid slides up from the camera position containing the incoming video. The flash should include a bright bloom effect and the polaroids should have that characteristic glossy sheen with a subtle reflection gradient. Include a mechanical 'whirr' sound effect timing if possible.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 2s overlap. Flash effect: white div at z-50 with opacity animation [0,1,0.8,0] over 0.3s at transition start. Outgoing polaroid: freeze last frame, apply 'brightness-150 contrast-125' for overexposed look, then animate translateY(0→120%) with cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55) for ejection curve. Incoming polaroid: starts at translateY(100%), animates to 0. Both polaroids use 'bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-white to-gray-50' for glossy effect. Add '::after' pseudo-element with gradient overlay for sheen.

prompts.prompt: Create a polaroid collage wall transition where the outgoing video splits into 9 mini polaroid frames arranged in a 3x3 grid that scatter outward with physics-based motion, while 9 segments of the incoming video fly in from various angles to form a new grid that then merges into the full video. Each mini polaroid should have slightly different rotation angles for a natural scattered look, and add subtle parallax movement based on mouse/device motion if supported.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.5s overlap. Create 18 BaseLayout polaroids (9 outgoing, 9 incoming) using 'grid grid-cols-3 gap-2' initially. Each polaroid with 'w-1/3 aspect-square bg-white p-2 shadow-lg'. Outgoing polaroids: split video using 9 VideoAtoms with different startFrom times, animate with random translateX/Y values (-200% to 200%) and rotate values (-45deg to 45deg). Incoming polaroids start offscreen with reverse random positions, animate to grid positions, then opacity transition to single full VideoAtom. Use 'will-change-transform' for performance.

prompts.prompt: Develop a polaroid time-lapse develop effect where the transition shows the chemical development process of instant photos. The outgoing video gradually becomes overexposed and washed out while curling at the corners like an old photo, as the incoming video emerges from complete darkness with color bleeding in from the edges toward center, simulating the actual polaroid development process. Add chemical stain effects and color shifts during the transition period.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 3s overlap for slow development. Outgoing video: apply increasing brightness filter [100%→200%], contrast [100%→50%], add curl effect using 'perspective-1000 rotateX(0→15deg) rotateY(0→-10deg)'. Incoming video: starts with 'brightness-0', animates to 'brightness-100'. Add radial gradient mask that animates from center outward for development effect. Color bleeding: use multiple colored divs with 'mix-blend-mode-overlay' that fade in/out during transition. Add noise texture overlay at 20% opacity.

prompts.prompt: Design a polaroid flip book animation transition where the outgoing video becomes a series of polaroid frames that flip away rapidly like a flip book, revealing the incoming video underneath which also starts as a flip book that slows down to normal playback. Each 'page' should have a slight 3D rotation and shadow to create depth, with acceleration/deceleration in flip speed for natural motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2s overlap. Create 20 polaroid 'pages' for outgoing video (sample every 0.1s of video), each as BaseLayout with VideoAtom showing specific frame. Animate pages with rotateY(0→180deg) in sequence with exponential timing, translateZ for depth. Incoming video: 20 pages that start flipping fast (0.05s intervals) then decelerate to normal playback. Use 'preserve-3d' transform-style on container, 'backface-hidden' on polaroids. Shadows using 'drop-shadow-2xl' that fade during flip.

prompts.prompt: Create a polaroid shake-to-develop transition mimicking the classic instant photo shaking gesture. The outgoing video transforms into a polaroid that shakes vigorously (alternating rotation and position) while fading to black and white, then gets tossed aside. Meanwhile, a new polaroid appears being shaken, gradually developing from a milky white state to reveal the incoming video with increasing color saturation and contrast over time.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.5s overlap. Outgoing polaroid: apply shake animation using keyframes for translateX([-5px,5px]), translateY([-3px,3px]), rotate([-2deg,2deg]) at 10Hz frequency, gradually apply grayscale(0→100%) and opacity(1→0). Toss animation: translateX(0→-200%), rotate(0→45deg) with ease-out. Incoming polaroid: starts with 'brightness-200 saturate-0 contrast-50', shakes at 8Hz, gradually animates to 'brightness-100 saturate-100 contrast-100'. White overlay div fades from opacity-80 to 0.

prompts.prompt: Build a polaroid vintage album page turn transition where both videos are displayed as polaroids on album pages. The outgoing video's page curls and flips over to reveal the incoming video on the next page. Include realistic page texture, photo corner holders, and handwritten caption effects. The page turn should have realistic physics with slight page deformation during the flip.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout as album container with 'bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-100 to-amber-50'. Two page BaseLayouts with 'bg-white shadow-inner'. Outgoing polaroid with decorative corners using absolutely positioned triangular divs 'border-8 border-transparent border-t-gray-800 rotate-45' at corners. Page turn: use clip-path polygon animation to create curl effect, combine with rotateY(0→-180deg) and translateX. Add gradient shadow that moves across page during turn. Incoming page starts with rotateY(180deg), flips to 0deg. Both polaroids have 'drop-shadow-xl' for depth.

prompts.prompt: Design a polaroid instant camera print queue transition where polaroids continuously emerge from the bottom of the screen like a camera printing multiple shots. The outgoing video splits into 3-4 polaroids that slide up and stack with slight rotation offsets, then scatter away, while new polaroids containing preview frames of the incoming video emerge and stack, with the final one expanding to full size.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 3s overlap. Outgoing: split into 4 VideoAtoms in polaroid frames, animate each with translateY(100%→0→-150%) with 0.2s stagger, rotate randomly between -5deg and 5deg. Stack with increasing z-index. Scatter animation: random translateX/Y and rotate values. Incoming: 4 preview polaroids emerge with same stacking animation, final polaroid scales from 0.8x to 1x to fill screen. Use 'transition-all duration-500 ease-out' for smooth animations. Motor sound effect could sync with emergence timing.

prompts.prompt: Create a polaroid chemical burn transition where the outgoing video appears to chemically burn away at the edges like an overheated polaroid, with the burnt areas revealing the incoming video underneath. The burn effect should include color distortion (reds/oranges/browns), bubbling textures, and gradual edge deterioration that spreads inward, while the incoming video has a fresh, high-contrast polaroid look.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 3.5s overlap. Outgoing video in polaroid frame at z-20, incoming at z-10. Burn effect: animated SVG filter with feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap for distortion, feColorMatrix for color shift to orange/brown. Mask with radial gradient that animates inward 'radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0%, black X%)' where X animates from 100 to 20. Add multiple divs with 'mix-blend-mode-multiply' containing gradient burns at edges. Incoming video has 'contrast-125 saturate-110' for fresh look. Particle divs with 'animate-ping' for ember effects.
